title: Dexcom G6 Bluetooth Connection Lost for Samsung Galaxy Watch
symptom: Lost connection for 4 hours after the last reading. The app says 'G6 state isn't currently known. Next connection will update this'. Bluetooth Link shows disconnected and Deep Sleeping Error count is at 10.
evidence_quote: Lost connection for 4 hours at this point, after the last reading. The app continues to say " G6 state isn't currently known. Next connection will update this" . I restarted the app after two hours and no change.
